# Money Hunters UK

> Independent UK site tracking bank switch bonuses, cashback and referral offers, with the conditions and the date each was last checked. Also plain-English money guides and a money game. Not financial advice. Some links are referral links (marked Ad) and we may earn a commission.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://moneyhunters.co.uk/): overview of offers, guides and the game
- [Bank switch bonuses](https://moneyhunters.co.uk/bank-switch.html): live UK switch offers with conditions and check dates
- [Offers](https://moneyhunters.co.uk/offers.html): all tracked offers
- [Guides](https://moneyhunters.co.uk/guides/): plain-English UK money guides, each with review date and sources
- [Coinsworth](https://moneyhunters.co.uk/play/): free money game
- [Newsletter](https://moneyhunters.co.uk/newsletter.html): UK money offers by email
